extracted.intended_audience: mathematicians and researchers considering submission to Acta Mathematica (potential authors, readers)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance/overview page for the journal Acta Mathematica describing its scope and publication characteristics for authors and readers. Useful for researchers deciding whether to submit original mathematics research.

rubrics_metrics.name: Original research of the highest quality
rubrics_metrics.description: Acta Mathematica contains original research papers of the highest quality in all fields of mathematics.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This states the journal's primary evaluative standard: submissions should be original research and meet very high quality standards. No further submission criteria or detailed standards are provided on this page; links to 'Submission of Manuscripts' are present for more information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope — all fields of mathematics
rubrics_metrics.description: The journal accepts original research across all fields of mathematics.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates broad topical scope within mathematics; suitability of a manuscript should be judged by its contribution to mathematical research rather than by a narrow subfield constraint.

rubrics_metrics.name: Open access availability
rubrics_metrics.description: Full texts of all Acta articles are freely available online.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Communicates the journal's access policy (articles freely available), which may be relevant to authors considering dissemination and readership but is not a submission-quality criterion itself.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publication frequency/volume size (informational)
rubrics_metrics.description: Two volumes, consisting of two issues each, are published annually, totaling about 800 pages per year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides context on journal throughput and selectivity (limited annual page budget), implying competition for space though not an explicit acceptance criterion.
